card.name: Linking words inside drug lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, or, a comma) right after a drug or condition name in a list of examples, where another item of the same class comes next, as in 'penicillins or' before cephalosporins.

modes.label: Or/and in drug class lists
modes.description: The word 'or' or 'and' follows a listed drug or enzyme name and introduces the next item.

modes.label: Comma in drug series
modes.description: A comma follows a drug name in a series before the next named drug.

card.writes: Promoted tokens look like starts of names (mel, Mel, combe), so it may prepare the next list item, but the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the 'or', 'and' or comma that sits between items in a list of related drugs or conditions.
